## 💡 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of what the feature or improvement is.

## 🎯 Problem It Solves
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? (e.g., "I need support for fine-grained finger phalange selection...")

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution / API Design
Describe how you envision the feature working and what the API / JSX props would look like:

```tsx
<Model
  type="anterior"
  data={myMuscleData}
  zoomable={true}
  onHover={(stats) => console.log(stats)}
/>
```

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## 🏢 Use Case
Explain the real-world application (e.g., Workplace Safety / EHS incident documentation in Plexa, athletic recovery tracker, telehealth pain map).

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, diagrams, or mockups here.
